text.tspan: Three related tables. Each one stores a fact exactly once.
PK = primary key, the column that identifies a
FK = foreign key, a pointer to a row in another
Each request belongs to exactly one category; each category is routed to exactly one department.
In the flat CSV the department name was repeated on every single row. Splitting the tables is how that duplication disappears.
